summary: Master cybersecurity auditing with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical skills to safeguard your organization and meet industry standards.
lede: Cybersecurity auditing helps IT auditors, security managers, and risk professionals assess controls and gather evidence. Training covers risk-based audit planning, developing audit work programs, testing identity, data, and infrastructure safeguards, reviewing incident response and third-party risks, and presenting findings with remediation steps in clear reports.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals responsible for providing assurance, managing risk, and ensuring the integrity of information systems in complex global environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in IT auditing, information security, or systems administration. A basic understanding of networking concepts, operating system security, and risk management principles is required. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001 or the NIST CSF is recommended but not mandatory. No programming or coding skills are required for this course.
